rationale: The agent did look up the user and order, but then executed an exchange write (exchange_delivered_order_items) without first confirming the exact replacements or charges with the user, violating the explicit requirement to confirm before any order-changing action. Moreover, the agent did not verify or present that the new items met the user’s specifications: product details were fetched for two product IDs that did not match the new_item_ids ultimately used, so the chosen replacements were unsupported by tool results. The final response did not summarize the exchange details, price differences, payment method usage, or timelines. While the user was authenticated and the order likely belonged to them, the lack of confirmation before the write and unsupported item selection mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
